snippet.title: Game Overview - Bio Blaster
snippet.description:
This is an overview of the features in version 1.1 of Bio Blaster by Point Vertex Games

Play the game in your browser here: https://point-vertex.itch.io/bio-blaster

Chapters
0:00 Start Menu w/ Volume Settings
0:15 Space FPS Controls & World Space HUD
0:27 2 Weapon Types & Proximity Detection
0:39 3 Enemy Types & Dynamic Spawning
1:05 End Screen with Score
